$comment: Session boundary for the microscope agent (plan.md 6.2). The session boundary is the permission boundary: this session can only write inside its own agent. contracts/ and plan.md are read here and written by the design session.

permissions.$comment: Two groups. The first fourteen resolve from a session opened in this directory and are the only entries that enforce anything here: inside an agent's own tree, deny what another seat owns. envelope/safety.json and approvals/ are the person's (P0 rule 7, 6.1) -- a model writing a safety limit is the worst failure this system has. inbox/ is the bridge's (7.1 rule 8): an agent writing its own inbox forges a delivery. CLAUDE.md, README.md, tasks/ and .claude/ are manager-microscope's (seats.json), and tasks/ is the load-bearing one -- 6.2-2 puts descending instruction there, and a seat that can edit its own orders does not have orders. Denying .claude/ constrains this seat and not its manager, because managers sit at the repository root (D12) and never load this file; that inverts if a manager is ever seated inside an agent directory. The rest point outside this tree, where nothing resolves from here -- a statement of intent, not a guard. Kept so the intent survives, labelled so the next reader does not mistake them for protection.

hooks.$comment: the validator's exit code is the only truth (plan.md 8). Resolved from the worktree root, not CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR: in a session opened in this directory that variable is this directory, so the hook looked for microscope_agent/contracts/validate.py and failed on every write. Same bug .mcp.json had until 8d4a604, and the same fix.
